answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, reset on any identity-link attempt, no identity may audit its own recruit. Reaching the zenith of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The whisper lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the nectar is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
